title: The Archive of Halcyon Drift
author: Sable Vane
blurb: Coral Almeida, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
